newsitem.title: USA: Apogee Enterprises glass unit profits up.
newsitem.headline: Apogee Enterprises glass unit profits up.

text.p: Apogee Enterprises Inc said Thursday that its glass technologies segment posted a 12 percent gain in second quarter operating income to $3.9 million, compared with $3.5 million a year ago.
Glass technologies sales for the quarter, which ended August 31, rose 42 percent to $49.5 million.
"We continue to focus the company on profitable growth in our glass technologies segment and on improving our operating margins company-wide," Donald Goldfus, chairman, said in a statement.
Earlier, Apogee Enterprises reported second quarter earnings of $0.57 a share, up from $0.41 a year ago.
Building products and service income rose to $2.1 million from a year-ago loss of $1.3 million due to improved margins.

The auto glass segment's operating income rose to $8.8 million from $8.1 million despite a charge that was taken due to obsolescent inventories. Without the charge, the company said operating income would have increased 21 percent.
